name: Astaroth
description: A Great Duke of Hell in Christian demonology, derived by demonisation from the Phoenician goddess Astarte / biblical Ashtoreth. Best known as Astaroth, ranked 29th in the Ars Goetia of the Lesser Key of Solomon, where he commands forty legions.

aliases.name: Ashtaroth
aliases.meaning: Plural of the Hebrew form of the goddess name; biblical Hebrew form

aliases.name: Ashtoreth
aliases.meaning: Singular biblical Hebrew form, used as a proper name in the Hebrew Bible

aliases.name: Astarte
aliases.meaning: Underlying ancient Near Eastern goddess from whom the demon name derives

regions: Christian Europe (medieval and early-modern grimoiric tradition)
origin: A textual phenomenon of Christian demonology and Western ceremonial magic, with antecedents in the ancient Near Eastern goddess Astarte and the biblical polemic against her cult.
